list.pageSubtitle: Every challenge, its current phase and how judging is going.
list.title: Title
list.empty: No challenges yet. Create the first one.

aggregationHelp.MEAN: The entry score is the average of all judges' scores.
aggregationHelp.MEDIAN: The middle score is used, so one extreme score has less effect.
aggregationHelp.TRIMMED_MEAN: Drops the highest and lowest score when there are 5 or more judges.
aggregationHelp.WEIGHTED_BY_REVIEWER: Each judge's score counts by their vote weight.

shortlistMethod.TOP_N_WITH_THRESHOLD: Top N with a minimum score

shortlistHelp.TOP_N: The best N entries go through.
shortlistHelp.THRESHOLD: Every entry at or above the score goes through.
shortlistHelp.TOP_N_WITH_THRESHOLD: The best N entries, but only if they reach the minimum score.
shortlistHelp.TOP_PERCENT: The best share of entries goes through.
shortlistHelp.MANUAL: The judges pick; scores are shown as guidance.

prototypeHelp.NONE: Shortlisted entries go straight to the final submission.
prototypeHelp.OPTIONAL: Entries may upload a prototype; it is scored only if uploaded.
prototypeHelp.REQUIRED_ALL: Every shortlisted entry must submit a prototype.
prototypeHelp.PANEL_DECIDES: In the shortlist, the judges mark which entries must prove feasibility first.

checklist.TITLE: Title and problem statement written
checklist.PHASES: Registration, methodology and review phases have dates
checklist.PANEL: Judges chosen (the admin can add them later)

builder.subtitle: Set up the problem, who can join, the timeline, judging and prizes. You can save a draft at any step.

stepHelp.basics: Name the challenge and say which business area it belongs to. Any area counts, not only technology.
stepHelp.problem: Describe the business problem in plain words. Participants see this on the challenge page.
stepHelp.eligibility: Choose who may register and whether they join alone or as a team.
stepHelp.timeline: Give each phase an opening and closing time. The server opens and closes phases on time.
stepHelp.forms: Choose the forms entrants fill in at each submission phase.
stepHelp.judging: Choose the scoring sheets. Criteria and weights are shown openly on the challenge page. The admin chooses the judges on the Judges tab.
stepHelp.shortlist: Set how the system proposes the shortlist after the methodology review.
stepHelp.prizes: List the prizes and choose what is shown publicly.
stepHelp.review: Check the summary and the checklist, then publish.

builder.titleBnHelp: Optional. Shown to people who use the app in Bangla.
builder.titleRequired: Give the challenge a title before saving.
builder.domainHelp: The business area of the problem.
builder.searchPeople: Search by name, role or department
builder.problem_statementHelp: What is the problem, who has it and how big is it?
builder.backgroundHelp: Context, data that is available and limits participants must respect.
builder.expected_outcomeHelp: What does success look like? Give a number if you can.
builder.eligibilityHelp: Tick the SBUs that may join. Leave all unticked to open it to every employee. Panel members are always excluded.
builder.eligibilitySome: Limited to {{count}} unit(s) and their sub-units.
builder.teamSizeError: The largest team can't be smaller than the smallest team.
builder.crossOrgHelp: Teams with people from different businesses tend to build things people use.
builder.lockedNote: Locked after publishing, so entrants keep the rules they registered under.
builder.lockedBanner: This challenge is published. Text, dates and prizes can still change. How people take part, team size, eligibility and the prototype policy are locked.
builder.timelineHelp: Registration, methodology and methodology review are required. Add the other phases your challenge needs. Phases may overlap.

issue.missing: {{phase}} is required and has not been added.
issue.incomplete: {{phase}} has no dates yet and will not be saved.
issue.window: {{phase}}: the closing time must be after the opening time.
issue.gap: There is a gap between {{phase}} and {{other}}. Nothing is open in between.

builder.formsHelp: Each challenge can use its own forms. Only published forms can be chosen.
builder.noPhaseNote: Used only if the timeline has a {{phase}} phase.
builder.judgesHelp: Only people who hold the Judge role are listed. A Super Admin assigns that role.
builder.judgesMin: Choose at least 3 judges. The challenge can't be published with fewer.
builder.blindHelp: Hide names, teams and departments from judges in the methodology stage.
builder.waitlistHelp: The next entries wait in case a shortlisted entry withdraws.
builder.tieBreak: Ties are broken by the scoring sheet's tie-breaker criterion, then the earlier submission, then a vote by the judges.
builder.humanConfirms: The system only proposes the shortlist. A person always confirms it, and any change needs a reason.
builder.publishWinnersHelp: After results, show winners' title, team name and short summary to everyone.
builder.showCountHelp: Shows a number only, never names.
builder.peoplesChoiceHelp: One vote per employee; votes stay hidden until results day.
builder.leaderboardHelp: Shows finalists' public summaries in rank order.
builder.privacyNote: These options show finalists' public summaries to other employees. They are off by default because participants normally never see other entries.
builder.checklistUnsaved: Save the draft to check it against the publish checklist.
builder.checklistStale: You have unsaved changes. The checklist shows the last saved version.
builder.publishBlocked: The challenge can't be published yet
builder.publishConfirmBody: Employees are notified and can see the challenge. After this, how people take part, team size, eligibility and the prototype policy can't be changed.

centre.subtitle: Manage this challenge
centre.draftNote: This challenge is a draft. Employees can't see it until you publish it.
centre.readOnly: Read only. You can view this challenge but not change it.
centre.noPhases: No phases are set up yet.
centre.extendBody: Extensions apply to every entry and are recorded in the audit log. Later phases move so they don't overlap.
centre.reasonAudited: Entrants are told about the new date. The reason is kept in the audit log.
centre.announceBody: Goes to everyone in the {{count}} registered entries, by notification and email.
centre.closeBody: The phase closes now and the next phase opens straight away. Submissions in a closed phase are locked.
centre.noOpenPhase: No phase is open right now.
centre.withdrawHelp: The entrant is notified and the reason is kept in the audit log.
centre.publishToAllHelp: Everyone sees the question and answer. The asker's name is never shown to other users.
centre.noRounds: No judging stages are set up for this challenge.
centre.noAssignments: No entries have been given to judges yet.
centre.assignResult: {{created}} new scoring tasks given out across {{entries}} entries
centre.assignNothing: No entries are ready for this stage yet.
centre.exclusions: Left out because of a conflict of interest:
centre.shortOfReviewers: Not enough free judges for: {{entries}}. Ask the admin to add judges.
centre.noDemo: Demo Day is not scheduled yet.

resultsStatus.NONE: The jury decision has not been recorded yet.
resultsStatus.DRAFT: Jury decision recorded. Waiting for approval.

centre.resultsHumanNote: The jury decides the winners. Results are published only after approval, and a top award needs a working solution.
centre.settingsLocked: Text, dates and prizes can still change. Structure is locked after publishing.
